build: Incremental existing locked-toolchain Windows Release Clang/Qt and Debug Core directories; no clean build claim

combined_same_product_coverage.note: Coverage across the complete 178-case run and the diagnosed cache rerun; not a single all-green run. Only cache-test timing/progress diagnostics changed after the complete run; product sources and assertions unchanged.

final_refinement: Bounded linear JUnit tag/attribute reader and bounded version regex; pressure case with 2048 ampersands plus a Unicode test name. Final replay/Qt and build-pass checks plus complete analysis run and diagnosed cache rerun cover the final product. Build/test failure diagnostics retain fixtures and stage logs. The 64-TU three-scan cache integration timeout was raised 120->300 seconds; production process timeouts and assertions unchanged.

cache_timeout_diagnosis.facts: One serial baseline snapshot committed, 43/64 cold-cache entries written at timeout; warm scan not reached. Max path 202. Diagnostic rerun: baseline 44.984s, cold complete 89.541s, warm complete 105.953s; 64 cache hits and issue equivalence passed. Test wall time 107.53s.
cache_timeout_diagnosis.scope: Test-only progress logging, failure retention, flushing and outer integration budget; no production algorithm or testcase content reduced.

initial_full_failures: Two unusually slow initial failures (limit 63s and build_pass 31s). Same binaries passed in 7s and 4s on immediate isolated recheck. Initial root cause was not established; raw failures retained. Final complete suite run separately with parallel=1 and direct log capture.

initial_junit_category_check.explanation: Test expected disabled to be counted as skipped; actual JUnit used disabled=1, skipped=0, status=notrun. Product already rejected the replay. Added separate disabled and not-run counts and corrected assertion.

real_projects.boundary: Prior 59 selected TU and 44 upstream tests belong to the previous build. This stage uses current full product regression and synthetic per-group fixtures; no real repair truth or new real-project accuracy claim.

sample_initial_scan.explanation: CMake C++20 automatic module scanning produced unsupported side-effect module options. The module-free demo now explicitly sets CMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES=OFF. Analyzer command rejection was retained.

semantics.group: One requested CTest test with transitive DEPENDS and automatically selected fixtures; selected_tests names checked against actual JUnit
semantics.environment: Counters isolated between groups; same build workspace and resource state reused
semantics.required: Every replay group passes and collects comparable lines; successful group line union equals aggregate; existing static/test/source gates retained
semantics.skipped: Disabled, skipped and not-run are separate JUnit fields; process exit zero is insufficient
semantics.limits: 1..256 declared tests, default limit 64; 8 MiB metadata, 1 GiB accumulated replay evidence checked after each group; inherited per-gcov bounds retained
semantics.remaining: Original-versus-modified multi-run coverage comparison, true repair correctness labels, deployment of a model, independent CI
